answer: Attackers creating thousands of fake agents must pay the full energy cost per identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent must burn compute solving a unique challenge tied to its identity, registered on a violet ledger entry. Honest agents amortize one-time costs like layered shale, while the registry's marble-like immutability prevents retroactive deletion, ensuring sustained scarcity of verified identities. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
